pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which sacred plant belongs to Buddhist tradition because of the Buddha's enlightenment? (1 mark)
   A. Tulsi
   B. Bodhi tree
   C. Ber tree
   D. Sal tree

2. Which Jain teacher is linked with the bank of the Rijubalika river? (1 mark)
   A. Valmiki
   B. Lord Mahavir
   C. Prahlad
   D. Guru Nanak

3. How can water be used in worship? (1 mark)
   A. To burn incense
   B. To make bells ring
   C. To wash the hands and feet before prayer
   D. To build the temple roof

4. Where does the River Ganga begin? (1 mark)
   A. In the Rift Valley
   B. In Lake Victoria
   C. At the Indian Ocean coast
   D. In the Himalaya mountains

5. If a classmate is being bullied, which teaching helps? (1 mark)
   A. Laugh
   B. Join the bullies
   C. Ignore it
   D. Stand up for the child who is troubled

6. In the story of the swan, who shot the swan? (1 mark)
   A. Devadatta
   B. Prahlad
   C. Siddhartha
   D. Suddhodana

7. What lesson does the Narsimha story teach? (1 mark)
   A. Faith is useless
   B. Bullies always win
   C. Kings never make mistakes
   D. Pride and cruelty do not last

8. Whom did Guru Ram Das Ji serve before becoming Guru? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Nanak
   B. Guru Amar Das Ji
   C. Guru Gobind Singh Ji
   D. Guru Arjan Dev Ji

9. Which Enlightened Being is Jain? (1 mark)
   A. Parshvanath
   B. Guru Ram Das
   C. Narsimha
   D. Prahlad

10. What was the name of Siddhartha's father? (1 mark)
   A. Hiranyakashipu
   B. King Suddhodana
   C. King Dasharatha
   D. Guru Amar Das

11. Who was Devadatta in the story? (1 mark)
   A. A Sikh Guru
   B. Siddhartha's cousin
   C. A Jain monk
   D. Siddhartha's father

12. Where is Lumbini today? (1 mark)
   A. In Uganda
   B. In Kenya
   C. In Punjab
   D. In Nepal

13. Who wrote the Ramayan in Sanskrit? (1 mark)
   A. Guru Arjan Dev
   B. Sage Valmiki
   C. Guru Nanak
   D. Sigala

14. Which action follows a Sikh teaching? (1 mark)
   A. Teasing the child
   B. Keeping it all
   C. Sharing lunch with someone who has none
   D. Hiding your lunch

15. How should we treat a scripture? (1 mark)
   A. By writing on it
   B. With cleanliness and respect
   C. By throwing it
   D. By sitting on it

16. What does Ik Onkar stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Six directions
   B. Two gods
   C. Many rivers
   D. There is one God

17. What does vidya mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Wealth
   B. Knowledge
   C. Friend
   D. Father

18. What does the Twameva prayer teach us about God? (1 mark)
   A. God is only a king
   B. God cares for us like a parent and friend
   C. God is far and angry
   D. God is a stranger

19. What does the white colour of Saraswati stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Purity and peace
   B. Anger
   C. Heat
   D. Hunger

20. How should we say the Gayatri Mantra? (1 mark)
   A. While running
   B. Slowly and clearly, sitting quietly
   C. While eating
   D. Shouting

21. You are sent to buy bread. What is honest behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Buy sweets with the change
   B. Keep some change
   C. Say the bread was more expensive
   D. Bring back the correct change

22. Which of these is honest saving? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding others' money
   B. Saving your own money and not taking from others
   C. Borrowing secretly
   D. Taking from another's savings

23. What does it mean to pay your fare honestly? (1 mark)
   A. Pay less
   B. Hide from the conductor
   C. Avoid paying
   D. Pay the right amount and take your change

24. In Sasankasana, where do your arms go at the end? (1 mark)
   A. On your head
   B. Behind your back
   C. In the air
   D. Stretched forward on the floor

25. Why do children work in pairs in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. To copy
   B. To check posture and encourage each other
   C. To argue
   D. To race

26. Which is a mistake in yoga practice? (1 mark)
   A. Being calm
   B. Wearing loose clothes
   C. Comparing yourself with others
   D. Following the teacher

27. Which of the five principles is about goals? (1 mark)
   A. Paramatma
   B. Punarjanam
   C. Prarthana
   D. Purushartha

28. Which of the five principles is about being born again? (1 mark)
   A. Prani Daya
   B. Punarjanam
   C. Purushartha
   D. Prarthana

29. What does Prarthana mean? (1 mark)
   A. Rebirth
   B. Prayer
   C. Wealth
   D. Duty

30. Which principle is being followed by greeting parents with Namaste and saying a morning prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Prarthana and respect for Paramatma
   B. Kama only
   C. Artha only
   D. Punarjanam only

31. Which is a kind of prayer? (1 mark)
   A. A race
   B. A school race
   C. A market
   D. A song of prayer called a bhajan

32. What does Param mean in Paramatma? (1 mark)
   A. Highest
   B. Small
   C. New
   D. Quiet

33. Why do the dates of Maha Shivratri and Paryushan change on the usual calendar? (1 mark)
   A. They follow the shops
   B. They follow the market days
   C. They follow the Moon
   D. They follow the school terms

34. How should we behave when the National Anthem is sung? (1 mark)
   A. Play
   B. Talk
   C. Run about
   D. Stand straight and be quiet

35. Which stories are told about Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. That it is the birth of the Buddha
   B. That it is a harvest festival of Kenya
   C. That it is a Jain festival of forgiveness
   D. That it is the night of Shiva and Parvati's wedding or of Shiva's great dance

36. What is the Sun in modern science? (1 mark)
   A. A star
   B. A planet
   C. A comet
   D. A moon

37. What is the Indian name for Wednesday? (1 mark)
   A. Somvaar
   B. Shanivaar
   C. Budhvaar
   D. Guruvaar

38. Which is a mistake? (1 mark)
   A. Learning the table
   B. Mixing up Guruvaar and Shukravaar
   C. Using a chart
   D. Making a song

39. What is the Indian name for Sunday? (1 mark)
   A. Mangalvaar
   B. Ravivaar
   C. Somvaar
   D. Shanivaar

40. Which day is linked with Jupiter? (1 mark)
   A. Tuesday
   B. Saturday
   C. Thursday
   D. Friday

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Name two things a lost and found corner needs. (2 marks)

42. Name the two Ramayan kaands studied in this lesson. (2 marks)

43. Explain how to say the Gayatri Mantra correctly. (3 marks)

44. Explain what the Sigalovada Sutta teaches about the six directions. (3 marks)

45. Name two parts of a Mandir. (2 marks)

46. Give the date and origin of International Yoga Day. (2 marks)

47. Why should we respect others who have different beliefs about death? (3 marks)

48. Describe how Maha Shivratri is celebrated. (3 marks)

49. Write a short composition on a festival of your choice. (5 marks)

50. List four facts about the planets linked with the days. (4 marks)

51. State what the Gayatri Mantra asks God to give us. (2 marks)

52. Name the two Jain scriptures in this lesson. (2 marks)

53. Compare Vajra Asana and Sasankasana. (5 marks)

54. Tell the story of the Ayodhya Kaand in three sentences. (3 marks)

55. Tell the story of Prahlad and Hiranyakashipu in three sentences. (3 marks)

56. List three ideal practices of a passenger while travelling. (3 marks)

57. Write the meaning of Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva. (3 marks)

58. Explain the four Purusharthas with one example each for a child. (4 marks)

59. Describe how to set up a lost and found corner in a classroom. (4 marks)

60. Give two ways water is used at home. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Bodhi tree
   Bodhi tree is the tree of awakening.

2. B — Lord Mahavir
   Lord Mahavir is believed to have become fully enlightened there.

3. C — To wash the hands and feet before prayer
   Washing before prayer is a way of showing cleanliness and respect.

4. D — In the Himalaya mountains
   The Ganga starts high in the Himalaya and flows across northern India.

5. D — Stand up for the child who is troubled
   Enlightened beings teach kindness and protecting others.

6. A — Devadatta
   Devadatta shot an arrow at the swan.

7. D — Pride and cruelty do not last
   Good defeats pride in the story.

8. B — Guru Amar Das Ji
   He served the third Guru with humility.

9. A — Parshvanath
   Parshvanath is a Tirthankar of Jainism.

10. B — King Suddhodana
   Siddhartha's father was King Suddhodana.

11. B — Siddhartha's cousin
   Devadatta was a cousin.

12. D — In Nepal
   Lumbini lies in Nepal.

13. B — Sage Valmiki
   Valmiki is honoured as its author.

14. C — Sharing lunch with someone who has none
   Sharing with others is a Sikh teaching.

15. B — With cleanliness and respect
   Scriptures are kept clean and high.

16. D — There is one God
   Ik Onkar means One God.

17. B — Knowledge
   Vidya is knowledge.

18. B — God cares for us like a parent and friend
   God is called our mother, father and friend.

19. A — Purity and peace
   White is a sign of purity.

20. B — Slowly and clearly, sitting quietly
   Calm and clear.

21. D — Bring back the correct change
   Bring back all correct change.

22. B — Saving your own money and not taking from others
   Honest saving respects others.

23. D — Pay the right amount and take your change
   Honesty includes paying fares.

24. D — Stretched forward on the floor
   Arms are stretched forward.

25. B — To check posture and encourage each other
   Pairs encourage and help.

26. C — Comparing yourself with others
   Yoga is not a competition.

27. D — Purushartha
   Goals of life.

28. B — Punarjanam
   Rebirth.

29. B — Prayer
   Prarthana is prayer.

30. A — Prarthana and respect for Paramatma
   Prayer and respect for God.

31. D — A song of prayer called a bhajan
   Bhajans are sung prayers.

32. A — Highest
   Param means highest.

33. C — They follow the Moon
   The Indian calendar is based on the Moon.

34. D — Stand straight and be quiet
   We show respect.

35. D — That it is the night of Shiva and Parvati's wedding or of Shiva's great dance
   Different stories are told.

36. A — A star
   The Sun is a star.

37. C — Budhvaar
   Budh is Mercury.

38. B — Mixing up Guruvaar and Shukravaar
   Guruvaar is Jupiter and Shukravaar is Venus.

39. B — Ravivaar
   Ravi is the Sun.

40. C — Thursday
   Guruvaar.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: A box or table for found items and a book to record the date and finder (any two sensible items).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Bal Kaand and Ayodhya Kaand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sit quietly with a straight back, close eyes and breathe slowly, say it one line at a time and listen first to a teacher or recording so you copy the sounds.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three points.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: It tells us to respect and care for parents, teachers, family, friends, workers and helpers, and holy teachers, and they in turn care for us.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for naming groups, 1 mark for respect and care, 1 mark for mutual duty.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Entrance, main hall, inner room (garbhagriha), spire (shikhara), bell (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 21 June, chosen by the United Nations.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the date, 1 mark for the United Nations.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: People hold different views, listening with respect keeps peace, and arguing does not help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: People fast, keep an all-night vigil, bathe the Shiva Linga with water and milk, offer bel leaves, chant Om Namah Shivaya and visit the Mandir.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct practice.

49. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any well-organised composition naming the festival, when it is held, what people do, what it teaches and how you feel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for name, timing, activities, meaning, and feeling.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: Mercury is closest to the Sun; Mars is the red planet; Jupiter is the largest; Saturn has rings (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: That the divine light guide our minds toward what is good and true (wisdom).
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for wisdom or guidance of the mind.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kalpasutra and Uttaradhyayan Sutra.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

53. (5 marks)
   Answer: Vajra Asana is sitting on the heels with a straight back. Sasankasana starts in Vajra Asana and bends forward with the forehead on the mat and arms stretched forward. Both are calm and use steady breathing.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each pose and 1 mark for a similarity.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: Dasharatha was about to hand the kingdom to Ram, but Kaikeyi asked that Bharat be king and Ram go to the forest for fourteen years. Ram accepted calmly and left with Sita and Lakshman. Bharat placed Ram's sandals on the throne and ruled in his name.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three correct points.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Hiranyakashipu was a proud king who wanted to be called God. His young son Prahlad kept praying to Vishnu. Lord Narsimha appeared from a pillar and defeated the king.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the proud king, 1 mark for Prahlad's faith, 1 mark for Narsimha.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wear the seat belt, sit still, keep hands and head inside, keep the aisle clear, do not litter, do not distract the driver, give up your seat (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: You are my mother and father. You are my relative and friend. You are my knowledge and wealth. You are everything to me, O God of gods.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair of lines, up to 3.

58. (4 marks)
   Answer: Dharma: doing homework and telling the truth. Artha: saving pocket money honestly. Kama: enjoying play and friendship. Moksha: praying and growing kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

59. (4 marks)
   Answer: Place a box or table in a safe place, write each item in a book with the date and finder's name, let owners claim their things, and thank those who return items.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four points.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: Drinking, cooking, washing, cleaning, watering plants or animals (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct use.
